The workbook generation failed due to invalid Excel formulas resulting in #NAME? errors during statistical calculations.
The test_derived_values_and_stats failed with an AssertionError in /tests/test_outputs.py. Multiple cells (H46, I46, J46, K46, L46, H47, etc.) returned '#NAME?' instead of the expected float values. This indicates that the generated Excel workbook contains unrecognized function names or invalid named ranges in the 'statistics' section of the 'Task' sheet.
